name: vault-generator
description: Agent Skill that turns a codebase or documentation set into an indexed Obsidian knowledge vault and retrieves only what a task needs.

plugins.name: vault-generator
plugins.description: Builds and maintains an indexed, navigable Obsidian knowledge vault from any codebase or documentation, and retrieves only the knowledge relevant to a question or task. Runs locally on Node.js 22.18+, with no network access.
